title: Contour Next One connection lost after bluetooth restart
body:
Hi,
First of all - thank you so so much! Your work is absolutely amazing and helps me and so many other people in our daily life :)

I use a Contour Next One to upload blood glucose readings directly via Bluetooth into xdrip+. Directly after starting the glucose meter I normally hear the sound on many phone that they are connected. Yet, after turning Bluetooth off and on on my phone I always have to go to the app and turn the data collection via the glucose meter off and on again as well. Otherwise the app/phone does not react to turning on the glucose meter as it did before restarting Bluetooth on the phone. Is there a way to fix this issue?

I downloaded xdrip about a month ago on my Samsung Galaxy S8 and gave the app all possible permissions.

Cheers! 
Timon

comments.body:
Fixed.
Restarted the phone, installed the newes xDrip+ version and turned on GPS - then it worked. I guess forgot to turn on GPS before.
